correctness.rationale: Exact polytope halfspaces follow from radial slices of the weight-k hypersimplex: x_i≥0, kx_i≤sum_j x_j, sum_jx_j≤k. Proposed center k/(n+1)1 and orthogonal shape eigenvalues u=min(k,n−k)^2/[n(n+1)], v=k²/[n(n+1)²] pass top, lower and oblique support inequalities, with active family switching exactly at 2k=n (both families active at equality). Exhibit n+1 contact points p0=(k/n)1 plus coordinate-lower or oblique contact orbit; their deviations sum to zero and n/(n+1) times their second-moment matrix equals Q. Positive John contact theorem then proves global unique maximal volume; determinant gives volume, u=v iff n+1=m²,k=m(m−1). Independent exact rational support/contact-moment checks at (3,1),(3,2),(4,2),(8,6),(9,3) passed. Endpoint ranks k=1,n−1 have appropriate redundancy. Finite source checker n≤25 does not replace proof.
